question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo>:</mo><mi>R</mi><mo>→</mo><mi>R</mi></math> be a continuous function such that <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mfenced><mi>x</mi></mfenced><mo>+</mo><mi>f</mi><mfenced><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></math> for all <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>R</mi></math>. If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>I</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><msubsup><mo>∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>8</mn></msubsup><mi>f</mi><mfenced><mi>x</mi></mfenced><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>I</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><msubsup><mo>∫</mo><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mn>3</mn></msubsup><mi>f</mi><mfenced><mi>x</mi></mfenced><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></math>, then the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>I</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><msub><mi>I</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> is equal to ________.

solution.text:
fx+fx+1=2

Replace x by x+1

fx+1+fx+2=2

By subtracting the equations, we get

fx=fx+2

⇒fx is periodic with period =2

I1=∫08fxdx=4∫02fxdx

=4∫01fx+f1+xdx=8

Similarly, I2=2×2=4

Hence, I1+2I2=16
